name: Canara Bank
title: Canara Bank - 532483 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Canara Bank FY26 profit 19,187 cr (+12.7%) with credit cost 0.59% and GNPA 1.84%, but Q4 flattered by 1,930 cr one-time listing gains; ECL transition ~10,000 cr absorbable, NIM guided 2.5-2.6%.

triggers.label: ECL impact ~10,000 cr, absorbable
triggers.quote: Roughly, we have calculated that the impact will be about 10,000 crores and looking at our profits, we can absorb in one go.

triggers.label: Gold loans 2.45 lakh cr, +~33-34%
triggers.quote: gold loan portfolio is growing at 33-34% of which the Agri gold portfolio is growing at around 15%.

triggers.label: Q4 slippage 2,771 cr; SMA down to 2.75%
triggers.quote: So, we do not see any stress building as on date, because it is almost at par with the previous March.

triggers.label: NIM +9bp QoQ; guided 2.5-2.6%
triggers.quote: So, we presume that it will hover around 2.5 to 2.6 here.

guidance.quote: the growth in business will be 11 to 12%

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT flattered by one-time listing gains; MTM losses 800 cr
red_flags.quote: So, sir, last quarter we had listing gains from Canara HSBC and Canara Robeco of 1930 crores.

red_flags.label: Large SMA-0/1/2 pool of 33,728 cr; 3 big SMA accounts provided 1,890 cr
red_flags.quote: there are three big ticket accounts which are in SMA, where there is no need for provision but we have made, as a prudent banker, we have made a provision of 1,890 crores in that.
